books.title: Introduction to R
books.outcome: Install R & RStudio, variables, data types, packages, getting help - zero to running code.

books.title: Data Wrangling with R
books.outcome: Import flat files and Excel, reshape with tidyr, clean with dplyr, pipes, tibbles, stringr, lubridate, forcats.
toc: Date & Time: Arithmetic and Time Zones

books.title: Data Visualization with ggplot2
books.outcome: Grammar of graphics, geoms, scales, facets, themes, position and stats tuning, and publication polish.
toc: Finale: Publication Polish with patchwork, ggrepel & ggtext

books.title: R, Databases & SQL
books.outcome: Connect R to databases with DBI, translate dplyr to SQL, write joins and production-grade queries.
books.prereq: 02 Data Wrangling first - database users may take 04 right after 02

books.title: Command Line Basics
books.outcome: Files, permissions, pipes and scripting - enough shell for R users. Windows path: RStudio Terminal, Git Bash or WSL.
extra_pages: Appendix: Git in 10 Minutes for RStudio Users (chapter 14)
books.prereq: None - take alongside 01. Windows users: RStudio Terminal / Git Bash / WSL

books.title: Data Visualization with Base R
books.outcome: The base graphics engine: parameters, multi-panel layouts and production export. Zero dependencies.
appendix_titles: Base R ↔ ggplot2: A Rosetta Stone
books.prereq: After 03 if you need fine-grained canvas control
